New member Hugh John combined with Matthew Taylor-Holland to place second as a team in the U17/U15 race (five runners should make up a team but such is the scarcity of young runners these days that a team placing can be achieved with less).

…7 Men’s event was early on our programme and it was a first ever taste of “big time” cross-country for fifteen year-old Hugh John. At the bottom end of the age group, he nevertheless had the courage to start strongly to claim a place in the 60s, hold that position throughout race, and then overtake…
U18 Men. 1 N James (Judd) 20:41; 3 H John 21:08.
